verdict.rationale: Data region and residency selection is a fair question for a SaaS collaboration and storage product like SharePoint, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents choosing a storage region or residency. The passing mention of on-premises SharePoint 2016 appears only in the context of REST batching and does not show a residency choice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
